Bill.BriefDescription: Addressing vehicle license plate and registration fraud.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to vehicle license plate and registration fraud;reenacting and amending RCW 46.63.020; adding a new section to chapter46.37 RCW; and prescribing penalties.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.37 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: It is unlawful for a person to display a license plate on a vehiclethat does not match or correspond with the registration of the vehicleunless the vehicle is inventory for a properly licensed vehicle dealer.A person who switches or flips license plates on a vehicle or falsifiesa vehicle registration in violation of this section, in addition to anytraffic infraction, is guilty of a gross misdemeanor punishable byconfinement of up to three hundred sixtyfour days in the county jailand a fine of five thousand dollars, which may not be suspended,deferred, or reduced. A vehicle that is found with an installedlicense plate flipping device may be impounded by a law enforcementofficer as evidence.
